# Proof artifacts

This directory contains evidence produced by the test commands, never invented product claims.

* `pure-tests.log` is generated by the deterministic local harness.
* `bench-test-*.log` is generated only after a real Frappe/ERPNext bench test completes through [`scripts/test-daytona.sh`](../scripts/test-daytona.sh) or [`scripts/test-marketplace.sh`](../scripts/test-marketplace.sh). The current final-head run is [`bench-test-20261024T072048Z.log`](bench-test-20261024T072048Z.log), captured from commit `aa0e4934132976033de265ace6d33e5c3ab52e4b`.
* [`screenshots/`](screenshots/) contains the capture manifest and naming rules. It is intentionally empty until a real, reviewable app UI is available.

The screenshot set is the real clean-bench capture listed in [`screenshots/manifest.json`](screenshots/manifest.json). A deterministic test log proves code paths only; it does not prove a Marketplace screenshot or deployment.
